messages:
maya: FYI I ran the runtime quickstart and hit a 403 on the example curl's Referer header. seems the design doc moved behind the internal repo and that URL now 403s. staging link: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/runtime/quickstart#auth :grimacing:
tony: ah ok. which file is the sample in? i can do a tiny PR if it's just the header line.
maya: `docs/runtime/quickstart.md`, around the curl example. it uses `https://internal.redwood.ai/designs/api-v1/auth` as the Referer. exact snippet:
```
curl -X POST \
  'https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/runtime/generate' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>' \
  -H 'Referer: https://internal.redwood.ai/designs/api-v1/auth' \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
we should either rehost a small auth excerpt in the KB or remove/replace the referer. rehosting preferred so docs stay self-contained.
doc-scan-bot: Link scanner: detected 1 broken external link in `docs/runtime/quickstart.md` -> https://internal.redwood.ai/designs/api-v1/auth. Flagged 2026-03-21T14:02:12Z.
tony: quick mitigation: can we temporarily change the referer to `https://docs.redwood.ai/kb/api-auth` so it doesn't 403? then follow up to rehost the minimal text. :eyes:
eli: i can rehost a one-paragraph auth caveat under `docs/kb/api-auth.md` and update the samples. i'll keep the language minimal to avoid i18n churn. planning to open a single PR that fixes `docs/runtime/quickstart.md` and `docs/examples/websocket-auth.md` (rg showed both).
jen: heads up for localization: since quickstart is included in ja guide, please keep the new text concise. if you add headings, indicate they are docs-only to avoid product comms. ping #i18n after merge.
maya: sounds good. eli, please add a one-line entry in the PR description for changelog: "docs: rehost api auth snippet and replace internal referer links". i'll smoke-test staging after merge.
tony: i'll run a quick ripgrep to ensure there are no other internal referer occurrences: `rg "internal.redwood.ai/designs/api-v1" docs || true`
tony: two hits found: `docs/runtime/quickstart.md:42` and `docs/examples/websocket-auth.md:18`. good catch.
eli: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12345 (will update title). commit message: "docs(kb): add minimal api-auth note; docs: replace internal referer". assigning to maya for review.
doc-scan-bot: Reminder: after merging, run `doc-scan-bot rescan docs/runtime/quickstart.md` to clear the alert.
jen: tiny ask: include a single sentence note in release notes that this is a docs-only rehost (no product change). saves support churn. :thumbsup:
maya: assigned to eli. ping me when PR is ready and i'll verify staging curl returns 200.
eli: on it, aiming to open the PR within the hour and will ping #docs when ready.
ton y: thanks everyone :raised_hands:
